Container.Name: media-ops
Container.Overview: Live dashboard for a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby + arr media server: what's up or down, who's streaming, library stats, downloads, upcoming releases, and one feed of errors from every app. Add your apps under Settings in the web UI. Built on the linuxserver.io Alpine base image (PUID/PGID/UMASK/TZ, Docker Mods).

Config.Name: Docker socket proxy
Config.Description: Optional: lists your containers through a read-only socket proxy (install socket-proxy from Community Apps with CONTAINERS=1, then enter tcp://socket-proxy:2375 or its IP). Safer than the Docker socket below.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional, not recommended: the raw Docker socket (/var/run/docker.sock). Read-only doesn't limit what can be asked of Docker, so anything that took over Media Ops would control the server. Prefer the socket proxy above.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 only when Media Ops is behind a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel: the settings-login lockout then counts each visitor instead of the proxy.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Name shown in the dashboard header

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as
